The new tests fail without the fix and pass with it. I ran `squeal proof .github/scripts/queue-ci-proof.test.cjs --base 6414b6c2~1`. It runs the test file from `6414b6c20` over the old code, then over the fixed code, in a temporary checkout, so your working tree is untouched.

**Red** (the new tests against the code at `24694ced5`, before the fix): 3 tests fail.

| Test | Failure without the fix |
|---|---|
| `a running queue run whose gate passed is proof while jobs outside the gate still run` | `false !== true` (the run is not accepted as proof) |
| `a running queue run whose gate passes during the bounded wait is proof` | `false !== true` |
| `a new attempt of a running queue run during the final read invalidates its proof` | got `reason: 'source-pending'`, expected `'source-changed'` |

**Green** (test and code at `6414b6c20`): the file passes.

Squeal's verdict: `1 proven, 0 not red, 0 red for another reason, 0 not green, 0 not comparable`. The run took 27.5 s of the 600 s budget.

**PR description text:**

> **Regression proof.** `squeal proof .github/scripts/queue-ci-proof.test.cjs --base 6414b6c2~1` runs the new tests over the pre-fix code (`24694ced5`) and over the fix. Without the fix, 3 tests fail:
> - A running queue run whose gate passed is not accepted as proof while jobs outside the gate still run (`false !== true`).
> - The same run is not accepted when its gate passes during the bounded wait (`false !== true`).
> - A new attempt during the final read returns `source-pending` instead of `source-changed`.
>
> With the fix, all pass. Squeal reports `1 proven, 0 not red, 0 not green`.

The command also printed warnings about the node-test preload `scripts/test-home-env.mjs` and incomplete static closures. They concern how Squeal selects tests, not the result.
